ablation_only.reason: Optional evidence with a cost that no controlled ablation has justified yet; off in the canonical run.
Not adopted until a controlled end-to-end comparison shows a benefit.
Sends frames to an external paid service; needs exact model identity and recorded availability and cost, and is compared, not adopted.
Speaks in task tokens; its translation to claims is a separate experiment.
Text-prompted concept segmentation with different semantics from SAM2.
No real execution is recorded; compared against DINOv2, not adopted.
Optional DAG stage; compared on the same DINO artifact, not adopted.
No verified checkpoint source; compared against CLIP if one exists.
Compared against the pose input as an estimator, not the baseline.

gates.evidence: Sequence artifact reader verification and the ingestion integrity report.
gates.requirement: The selected window of the SequenceArtifact validates with zero integrity violations, holds RGB and LiDAR under the one declared clock, carries a calibration identity, and its selection identity equals the scenario's.

gates.evidence: State estimation run artifact, lookup outcomes and the pose-gap report.
gates.requirement: Every selected image and LiDAR timestamp resolves to a pose, exact or interpolated within the declared lookup policy, or is rejected explicitly; the frame graph connects every sensor frame to the map frame.

gates.evidence: State estimation evaluation report with the comparison protocol.
gates.requirement: ATE and RPE are reported against an independent trusted reference; when the trajectory is the declared pose input itself they are reported as not applicable, never as zero.

gates.evidence: Geometric map artifact, transform traces and the round-trip report.
gates.requirement: The map is expressed in the trajectory's frame, every source point of the selected scans has an auditable transform trace, geometry references are stable, and the map survives a round trip through its artifact unchanged.

gates.evidence: Geometric mapping evaluation report.
gates.requirement: Density, range, bounds and scan-to-scan overlap of the map are reported with their sampling protocol.

gates.evidence: Perception run artifact and its multi-run reader.
gates.requirement: Every selected frame has a perception result with an explicit status per stage; failures are recorded rather than dropped, and each claim carries its backend, model, prompt policy and source region.

gates.evidence: Region discovery evaluation against the reference set.
gates.requirement: Region overlap, recall and duplicate rate are reported over the annotated frames.

gates.evidence: Semantic interpretation evaluation against the reference set.
gates.requirement: Acceptable, unsupported and ambiguity-preserving claim rates are reported; an unannotated open-vocabulary concept is never counted as wrong.

gates.evidence: Sensor association run artifact and its calibration and timing diagnostics.
gates.requirement: Every SpatialObservation references geometry that exists in the run's map, the visible, occluded, outside and invalid counts add up, and a frame without a valid pose is rejected explicitly.

gates.evidence: Sensor association evaluation report.
gates.requirement: Visible support, reprojection error and feature anchoring are reported by stratum with an explicit unavailable stratum.

gates.evidence: Semantic fusion run artifact and its lineage.
gates.requirement: Fusion consumes only the run's spatial observations, groups repeated inference over one physical observation instead of duplicating it, keeps alternatives and conflicts as uncertainty, and creates no object identity.

gates.evidence: Semantic fusion evaluation against the reference set.
gates.requirement: Reference recovery, ambiguity retention and multi-view consistency are reported over the annotated supports.

gates.evidence: Entity resolution run artifact and the entity materialization artifact.
gates.requirement: Every resolved entity lists its member entities and their fused evidence, every merge, split or keep decision records the evidence it used, and an undecided case stays unresolved.

gates.evidence: Entity resolution evaluation against the identity annotations.
gates.requirement: False merges, duplicates and semantic accuracy are reported separately, so a resolution error is never attributed to fusion or the reverse.

gates.evidence: Spatial relations run artifact.
gates.requirement: Every relation references resolved entities of the run and carries its evidence; a relation never replaces the evidence that supports it.

gates.evidence: Spatial relations evaluation against the relation annotations.
gates.requirement: Relation precision and recall are reported by predicate, with explicit negatives kept apart from missing annotations.

gates.evidence: Artifact reader verification and the round-trip report.
gates.requirement: The ContextMapArtifact reads back on the base install with verified hashes and without mutation, its dependency closure is complete, and it references geometry rather than copying it.

gates.evidence: Cross-stage lineage check over the persisted artifacts.
gates.requirement: Every stage artifact names the exact upstream artifacts it consumed and each equals the artifact actually read; the dependency closure of the final artifact has no unnamed input.

gates.evidence: Cross-stage coordinate check over the persisted artifacts.
gates.requirement: One map frame runs from trajectory to geometry to association to entities; every boundary states its frame and units and no stage converts implicitly.

gates.evidence: Cross-stage trace of sampled final facts back to source observations.
gates.requirement: Sampled final entities and relations trace to the exact source observations and geometry through the recorded path, and no stage repaired an invalid upstream artifact.

gates.evidence: Cross-stage check of physical observation identity across fusion and entities.
gates.requirement: Repeated inference over one physical observation never becomes duplicated physical evidence downstream.

gates.evidence: Run manifest and stage provenance.
gates.requirement: Every stage artifact records the exact backend, model revision or checkpoint hash and the effective configuration digest; an external service records its availability and cost metadata.

gates.evidence: Resource profile of the canonical run.
gates.requirement: Wall time, throughput, peak CPU memory, peak GPU memory with device and precision, storage and counts are recorded per stage with the warm or cold, reuse and selection-size conditions; failures and out-of-memory stay explicit.

gates.evidence: Comparison of repeated canonical runs.
gates.requirement: Repeated canonical runs select the same stages and configuration and yield equivalent artifacts, metric reports and final map within the documented tolerance of each stage.

gates.evidence: Fault-injection run and its resume record.
gates.requirement: A run interrupted at a representative stage resumes by reusing immutable artifacts, never promotes an incomplete artifact and preserves lineage.

stages.rationale: corridor-02 is a ROS 1 bag; the adapter only yields canonical observations.
Local, open-weight backends that already ran on the sample and fit an 8 GB GPU. SAM2 segments without labels, so segmentation is not read as classification.
The dataset trajectory is a declared pose input; the canonical run does not need a container. An estimator run is an ablation, not the baseline.
One persistent map in the trajectory frame; each policy has one option today.
Calibrated projection with explicit visibility and occlusion policies.
The baseline policy is the reference every option is compared with; no decision to adopt the quality-aware policy has been taken.
Materializes entities from fused evidence without cross-support merging.
Decides identity across supports; prefers unresolved to a silent merge.
Derives relations from resolved entities and never replaces their evidence.
The portable ContextMapArtifact is the product of the repository.

subject.note: Real recorded 90 s window of corridor-02 (a straight run plus turns, pose gaps <= 605 ms). The sequence artifact holds no pose observations, so the trajectory is read from the dataset trajectory file as a declared pose input, which makes trajectory accuracy against that same file not applicable. No annotated reference set exists for it yet: gates that need annotations are blocked, not scored.
